title: Paint palette with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="paletteGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E8C88A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C89B5A"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- Palette body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="55" rx="40" ry="32" fill="url(#paletteGrad)" stroke="#D4AE6E" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Thumb hole -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="72" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#2A1F10" stroke="#A07840" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Paint blobs -->
  <circle cx="28" cy="40" r="8" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="34" r="7" fill="#4DA6FF"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="34" r="7" fill="#FFD94D"/>
  <circle cx="74" cy="42" r="7" fill="#4DFF88"/>
  <circle cx="78" cy="58" r="6" fill="#C44DFF"/>
  <circle cx="64" cy="64" r="5" fill="#FF8C4D"/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="42" cy="52" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2A1F10"/>
  <ellipse cx="58" cy="52" rx="4" ry="5" fill="#2A1F10"/>
  <circle cx="43" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="50" r="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 40 60 Q 50 70 60 60" fill="none" stroke="#2A1F10" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="34" cy="58" r="4" fill="#FF9999" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="66" cy="58" r="4" fill="#FF9999" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- Paintbrush -->
  <rect x="82" y="18" width="4" height="28" rx="1" fill="#8B5E3C" transform="rotate(25 84 32)"/>
  <rect x="82" y="14" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#C0C0C0" transform="rotate(25 84 18)"/>
  <circle cx="88" cy="12" r="4" fill="#FF4D4D" transform="rotate(25 84 32)"/>
</svg>
